title: VIEW DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local VIEW direct-codec transaction control across legacy inline, detached, separate, and aliased stream layouts

implementation.behavior: Stage the body, detached string destination, and detached handle destination while preserving aliasing and version-specific VIEW fields, ambient color encoding, UCS data, and common/resource handle roles. Publish only after every staged stream succeeds.

control.profile: Locally generated VIEW with two reactors, extension dictionary, UCS association, nondefault view geometry and twist, modern lighting fields, and all modeled xref/background/visual-style/sun/live-section handles.

validation.result: The allocation control reports all seven layouts passing rollback/retry across 141 offsets. All six focused CTests passed, including generated peer and original-source VIEW/UCS checks.
